lines.zh: 水晶的光照着我，我慢慢走。
lines.en: Crystal light on me, I walk slowly.
Even in the endless night, the grass knows me.
My little hooves are worn shiny.
My herd is up ahead.
My shadow is short and easy to step on.

lines.zh: 午夜水晶下，我的步子最稳。
lines.en: Under Midnight crystals, my steps are steadiest.

lines.zh: 永夜的草，我闭着眼也认得。
lines.en: I know the eternal-night grass even blind.

lines.zh: 我边走边啃路边的嫩芽。
lines.en: I nibble roadside shoots as I walk.

lines.zh: 这片暗紫色的草，走起来软。
lines.en: This dark purple grass is soft underfoot.

lines.zh: 午夜的星子，落在我背上。
lines.en: The midnight stars have settled on my back.
The grass is taller than my ears.
I trot like a bouncing marble.
I take a small turn to graze.
Someone trampled my grass bed.
Short legs can only go so fast.
I must get back to my burrow before dark.

lines.zh: 午夜的光落在身上，我有点冷。
lines.en: Midnight light on me feels cold.
The wind tickles my ears.

lines.zh: 午夜的天空，蓝得没有尽头。
lines.en: The Midnight sky is blue without end.

lines.zh: 永夜的水晶，照得我发懒。
lines.en: The Midnight crystals make me lazy.

lines.zh: 我在数哪丛草明天还嫩。
lines.en: I'm counting which tuft will still be tender.
I thought someone called my name.
The sky here is always black.
Only grass blades rub together.
I lie down and tuck my legs.
I am blanking out in all this dark.

lines.zh: 永夜的水晶光，落在我身上。
lines.en: Crystal light of the endless night falls on me.
I bury my head back in the grass.

lines.zh: 影子凉快，我多站一会儿。
lines.en: The shade is cool; I will stand a while.
Grass and water are enough.

lines.zh: 第十七只蚂蚁钻进洞了。
lines.en: The seventeenth ant enters the hole.
I can doze standing up.
I will stay like this a while.

lines.zh: 午夜的光，照不暖这片草。
lines.en: Midnight's light does not warm this grass.

lines.zh: 你的靴子没有沾过这里的泥。
lines.en: Your boots have never touched this mud.

lines.zh: 我身上没什么能给你的。
lines.en: I've nothing on me for you.

lines.zh: 午夜的洞口，我又醒了一次。
lines.en: At the Midnight's door, I woke again.
You smell of blade and rust.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子去嗅你的手。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to sniff your hand.

lines.zh: 我抬起前蹄挡在你面前。
lines.en: I raise a forehoof in front of you.
The Midnight's light is on my back.
My steps leave light in the midnight grass.

lines.zh: 我盯着你头上的东西看。
lines.en: I stare at the thing on your head.
I back away two steps.
The night is long here, sit down.
I recognize your footsteps.
I bite down and refuse to cry.
Under crystal light my legs shake.

lines.zh: 午夜的光太冷，毛都竖了。
lines.en: The midnight light is cold; my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 我的咩声在永夜里变了调。
lines.en: My bleat changes pitch in the endless night.
I turn my head looking for who.

lines.zh: 这片永夜很静，疼也显得响。
lines.en: The endless night is quiet, so pain sounds loud.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我毛都打竖了。
lines.en: That blow stood my fur on end.

lines.zh: 午夜的维度里，我慢慢走。
lines.en: In the Midnight dimension, I walk slow.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音都抖了。
lines.en: I tried to call out and my voice shook.

lines.zh: 我这身皮，被打出淤青了。
lines.en: A bruise is rising on my hide.

lines.zh: 我小跑着冲向那簇青草。
lines.en: I trot straight at the green tuft.

lines.zh: 永夜里，我只认晶体的光。
lines.en: In endless night, I only know crystal light.
That glow here — I'll follow it.
My mouth is already wet.
I nuzzle up to your hand.
My forelegs buckle, I nearly kneel.
You have grass, I follow you.

lines.zh: 这里的光是紫色的，我认得。
lines.en: The light here is purple; I know it.
You know which shoots I like.
All light here comes from crystal.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子贴上了你的口袋。
lines.en: My nose presses to your pocket.
Lower the grass to my mouth.
That star. Truly for me?

lines.zh: 我一步不离地跟着那把草。
lines.en: I stick close to that bundle of grass.

lines.zh: 这味道勾得我耳朵直抖。
lines.en: The smell makes my ears twitch.
I stare at the grass without blinking.
My herd bunches into a line.

lines.zh: 蹄子被踩了，你走路看地。
lines.en: You stepped on my hoof — watch the ground.
I'm not a wall. Stop leaning.
My nose stings from the bump.

lines.zh: 你的脚差点踩到我的蹄。
lines.en: Your foot nearly crushed my hoof.

lines.zh: 我的角顶到了你的膝盖。
lines.en: My horn pokes your knee.

lines.zh: 我们卡在同一条小径上。
lines.en: We are stuck on the same narrow path.

lines.zh: 裂隙旁边，石头都是凉的。
lines.en: By the rift, the stones are always cold.
One bump and the stardust scatters.

lines.zh: 午夜的晶体光，照得我发亮。
lines.en: The Midnight's crystal light makes me shine.

lines.zh: 我把额头贴上它的额头。
lines.en: I press my forehead to theirs.
I licked my shoulder fur smooth.
The Midnight wind smells of young grass.

lines.zh: 我们并排啃着同一丛草。
lines.en: We graze the same tuft side by side.
In the moonlight I walk half a circle round it.

lines.zh: 它的耳朵在月光下发亮。
lines.en: Its ears shine in the moonlight.
The Midnight is long. Slow down.
I lean my neck against its side.
The sun never rises here.

lines.zh: 水晶边那丛嫩草，我推给它。
lines.en: I nudge the tender tuft by the crystals to it.

lines.zh: 我顺嘴叼走了那根枝条。
lines.en: I snatch the twig in passing.

lines.zh: 我把那颗果子拱到脚下。
lines.en: I nudge the fruit under my hooves.

lines.zh: 我叼起第二个藏进草里。
lines.en: I carry a second into the grass.

lines.zh: 这东西不像草，也不像土。
lines.en: It is neither grass nor soil.
This on the ground — dropped, right?
Not many bright things left here.
I'll keep this shard of light.

lines.zh: 这么亮的一块，我叼得动。
lines.en: A piece this bright — I can carry it.
I've never seen the likes of this.
In eternal night, I count as light.
The grass moves, I see it.
I lower my head, my small horns at you.

lines.zh: 午夜维度的草丛太深了。
lines.en: The grass in this Midnight realm is too deep.
I charge straight at that tuft.
You crossed the line I marked in grass.
In the Midnight dark, you'll do.

lines.zh: 我盯上了你手里的青草。
lines.en: I fix on the grass in your hands.
I stamp my forehooves twice.

lines.zh: 午夜的光，照不透我的毛。
lines.en: Midnight light can't get through my coat.
My fawn hides in the grass.

lines.zh: 我从你膝边钻过，往草丛去。
lines.en: I slip past your knee and into the grass.

lines.zh: 永夜里没有方向，你也一样。
lines.en: There is no direction in the endless night, and neither do you.
I've been walking at the back of the line.

lines.zh: 这条小径只通向我的窝。
lines.en: This path leads only to my burrow.
My short legs are doing their best.
Are you keeping that grass?
I know which tuft is sweet.
My hoofbeats grow closer.
In endless night my shadow runs long.
This scent is not grass.
My hooves are harder than my mouth.
I only used a third of my strength.
Your arrow is still in my shoulder.
I hop up and hit your hip.
My hind hooves kick up dirt.

lines.zh: 我用额头碰你，只是打个招呼。
lines.en: I bump you with my brow, just a greeting.
I shake my head and back off.
I butt my brow into your shin.

lines.zh: 撞飞你，午夜的光别怪我。
lines.en: I will knock you flying; blame the Midnight light.
My forehoof slaps your foot.
Every road here leads back.
I'm Nova. Nice to meet you.

lines.zh: 裂隙刚关，我就站在这儿。
lines.en: The rift just closed. Here I stand.

lines.zh: 午夜维度，我又冒出来了。
lines.en: Out of the Midnight realm I surface again.
I shake the grass bits off.
The soil here is damp.

lines.zh: 午夜维度里，哪来的太阳。
lines.en: In the Midnight dimension, what sun is there?
I just landed, my hooves tremble.
The night light makes me squint.
First thing after being born is eating.
Flames are climbing; brush them off.
I land flat on my back.
Water rises over my short legs.
After the blast my ears go numb.
Can't dodge. Here comes another.
The magic makes my fur stand.
Too hungry to stand.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我身上一股焦味。
lines.en: Lightning struck; I smell scorched.

lines.zh: 午夜下坠，水晶的光在头顶。
lines.en: Falling through midnight, crystals above.
